rows.source_ko: 해양수산부 (해양수산과학기술정책과), 051-773-6221, 6222
rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Marine Science and Technology Policy Division ), 051-773-6221, 6222

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「해양수산과학기술 육성법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Marine Fisheries Science and Technology Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제1조의2(해양수산과학기술 육성 기본계획 등의 공표) 해양수산부장관은 「해양수산과학기술 육성법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제6조의2제2항에 따라 해양수산과학기술 육성 기본계획 및 해양수산과학기술 육성 시행계획을 수립하거나 변경한 때에는 관보에 고시하거나 해양수산부의 인터넷 홈페이지에 게재해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1-2 (Publication of Basic Plan for the Promotion of Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology, etc.) When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries establishes or amends the Basic Plan for the Promotion of Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology and the Implementation Plan for the Promotion of Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 2 of the Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), he/she shall publish them in the Official Gazette or post them on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries.
[This Article Newly Inserted July 15, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(연구개발과제평가단의 구성 및 운영 등) ① 해양수산부장관은 「해양수산과학기술 육성법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제7조제1항에 따른 연구개발과제평가단(이하 “연구개발과제평가단”이라 한다)을 구성하기 전에 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람으로 연구개발과제평가단 후보단(이하 “후보단”이라 한다)을 구성하여 관리하여야 한다. <개정 2019. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Composition and Operation, etc. of the Research and Development Project Evaluation Team) ① Before constituting a research and development project evaluation team (hereinafter referred to as the “Research and Development Project Evaluation Team”) pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of Marine Science and Technology (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall constitute and manage a candidate team for the Research and Development Project Evaluation Team (hereinafter referred to as the “Candidate Team”) consisting of persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended July 15, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국가연구개발사업의 관리 등에 관한 규정」 제25조제10항에 따른 평가위원 후보단에 속하는 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Persons belonging to the pool of candidates for evaluation committee members pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 10 of the "Regulations on the Management, etc. of National Research and Development Projects."

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 인정하는 해양수산과학기술 분야의 전문가
rows.text_en: 2. Other experts in the field of marine and fisheries science and technology recognized by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: ② 해양수산부장관은 제1항에 따른 후보단 중에서 그 성별을 고려하여 5명 이상 13명 이내의 연구개발과제평가단을 구성한다. <개정 2019. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall form an R&D project evaluation team consisting of five to thirteen members from among the candidate group under Paragraph 1, taking into consideration gender. <Amended July 15, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 연구개발과제평가단의 평가는 서면평가, 대면평가 및 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 정하는 평가 중 하나 이상을 선택하여 실시한다. <개정 2019. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: ③ The evaluation by the R&D Project Evaluation Team shall be conducted by selecting one or more of the following: written evaluation, face-to-face evaluation, and other evaluations determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended July 15, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ④ 해양수산부장관은 제3항에 따른 각 평가 결과에 따라 법 제8조제1항에 따른 해양수산과학기술 연구개발과제(이하 “연구개발과제”라 한다)를 선정하되, 각 평가 결과 중 100점 만점에 60점 미만이 있는 경우에는 연구개발과제 선정대상에서 제외하여야 한다. <개정 2024. 9. 13.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall select research and development projects for marine and fisheries science and technology pursuant to Article 8 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “research and development projects”) based on the results of each evaluation under Paragraph 3; provided, however, that any evaluation result with a score of less than 60 out of 100 points shall be excluded from the selection of research and development projects. <Amended Sep. 13, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항부터 제4항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 연구개발과제평가단의 구성ㆍ운영 및 평가방법 등 연구개발과제의 선정에 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정한다. <개정 2019. 7. 15.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the selection of research and development projects, such as the composition and operation of the research and development project evaluation team and evaluation methods, shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended July 15, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(센터평가단의 구성 및 운영 등) ① 해양수산부장관은 영 제9조의2제2항에 따른 센터평가단(이하 “센터평가단”이라 한다)을 구성하기 전에 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람으로 센터평가단 후보단을 구성하여 관리해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Composition and Operation of the Center Evaluation Team, etc.) ① Before constituting the Center Evaluation Team pursuant to Article 9-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “Center Evaluation Team”), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall form and manage a candidate team of the Center Evaluation Team consisting of persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「국가연구개발사업의 관리 등에 관한 규정」 제25조제10항에 따른 평가위원 후보단에 속하는 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Persons belonging to the pool of candidates for evaluation committee members pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 10 of the "Regulations on the Management, etc. of National Research and Development Projects."

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 인정하는 해양수산과학기술 분야의 전문가
rows.text_en: 2. Other experts in the field of marine and fisheries science and technology recognized by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: ② 해양수산부장관은 제1항에 따른 센터평가단 후보단 중에서 그 성별을 고려하여 5명 이상 13명 이내의 센터평가단을 구성한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall form a Center Evaluation Team consisting of at least 5 and no more than 13 members from among the candidates for the Center Evaluation Team pursuant to Paragraph 1, taking into consideration their gender.

rows.source_ko: ③ 센터평가단의 평가는 서면평가, 대면평가 및 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 정하는 평가 중 하나 이상을 선택하여 실시한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The evaluation by the Center Evaluation Team shall be conducted by selecting one or more of the following: a written evaluation, an in-person evaluation, and other evaluations determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries .

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 센터평가단의 구성ㆍ운영 및 평가방법 등에 관한 세부사항은 해양수산부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters concerning the composition and operation of the Center Evaluation Team and evaluation methods, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries .
[This Article Newly Inserted July 15, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제2조의3(연구 장비ㆍ시설 관리 전문기관 지정기준 등) ① 법 제11조제3항에 따라 연구 장비ㆍ시설 관리 전문기관으로 지정받으려면 다음 각 호의 기준을 모두 갖추어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2-3 (Criteria for Designation of Specialized Institutions for Research Equipment and Facility Management, etc.) ① In order to be designated as a specialized institution for research equipment and facility management pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 3 of the Act , all of the following criteria must be met.

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 기관일 것
rows.text_en: 1. It must be an institution falling under any of the following subparagraphs

rows.source_ko: 가. 법 제23조제1항에 따른 해양수산과학기술진흥원(이하 “진흥원”이라 한다)
rows.text_en: a. The Korea Institute of Marine Science & Technology Promotion pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Institute”)

rows.source_ko: 나. 「한국해양과학기술원법」에 따라 설립된 한국해양과학기술원 또는 그 부설기관
rows.text_en: B. The Korea Institute of Ocean Science & Technology or its affiliated institutions established pursuant to the Korea Institute of Ocean Science & Technology Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 그 밖에 해양수산과학기술 분야의 연구 장비ㆍ시설 관리와 관련하여 전문성이 있다고 해양수산부장관이 인정하여 고시하는 기관
rows.text_en: C. Other institutions recognized by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries as possessing expertise in the management of research equipment and facilities in the field of marine and fisheries science and technology, as notified by public notice.

rows.source_ko: 2. 연구ㆍ장비 시설의 공동활용 촉진을 위한 사업계획, 전문인력 등 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시하는 기준을 충족할 것
rows.text_en: 2. Satisfy the standards prescribed and notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, such as business plans and specialized personnel, for the promotion of the joint use of research and equipment facilities.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제11조제3항제4호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 11, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 4 of the Act , “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 연구 장비ㆍ시설의 공동활용 관련 연구 및 기술지원
rows.text_en: 1. Research and technical support related to the joint use of research equipment and facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. 연구 장비ㆍ시설의 공동활용 실적 관리 및 성과 분석
rows.text_en: 2. Management of Joint Utilization Performance and Performance Analysis of Research Equipment and Facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 연구 장비ㆍ시설의 공동활용을 위한 협의체 구성 및 운영
rows.text_en: 3. Formation and operation of a consultative body for the joint use of research equipment and facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 연구 장비ㆍ시설의 공동활용을 촉진하기 위하여 필요하다고 해양수산부장관이 인정하여 고시하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries and notified to promote the joint use of research equipment and facilities
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 13, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(해양수산과학기술 분류체계 작성) ① 해양수산부장관은 법 제12조제1항에 따른 해양수산과학기술 분류체계(이하 “분류체계”라 한다)를 작성하는 경우에는 그 초안을 작성하여 관계 기관 및 단체, 관련 학회 등의 의견 수렴을 거쳐 분류체계를 확정한다. <개정 2019. 7. 15., 2024. 9. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Preparation of Classification System for Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology) ① When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries prepares the Classification System for Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Classification System”), the Minister shall prepare a draft thereof and finalize the Classification System after gathering opinions from relevant agencies and organizations, related academic societies, etc. <Amended July 15, 2019; September 13, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 해양수산부장관은 제1항에 따라 분류체계를 작성하는 경우에는 「과학기술기본법」 제27조제1항에 따른 국가과학기술표준분류표와 연계되도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries establishes a classification system pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall ensure that it is linked to the National Standard Classification of Science and Technology pursuant to Article 27, Paragraph 1 of the Framework Act on Science and Technology .

rows.source_ko: ③ 해양수산부장관은 해양수산과학기술 분야의 국제동향 및 신기술 출현 등을 고려하여 5년마다 분류체계를 수정ㆍ보완하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall revise and supplement the classification system every five years, taking into account international trends and the emergence of new technologies in the field of marine and fisheries science and technology.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(해양수산과학기술 정보) 법 제13조제1항제4호에서 “해양수산부령으로 정하는 정보”란 다음 각 호의 정보를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Information on Marine Science and Technology) The term “information prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” in Article 13, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act refers to the information in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양수산 분야 연구개발 투자통계 등에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 1. Information on R&D investment statistics, etc. in the marine and fisheries sector

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양수산과학기술의 사업화 등에 관한 정보
rows.text_en: 2. Information on the commercialization, etc. of marine and fisheries science and technology

rows.source_ko: 제5조(해양수산과학기술 수요조사) ① 해양수산부장관은 법 제14조에 따른 해양수산과학기술 수요조사를 하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 항목이 포함되도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Survey on Demand for Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology) ① When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries conducts a survey on the demand for marine and fisheries science and technology pursuant to Article 14 of the Act , he/she shall ensure that the following items are included.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해양수산과학기술의 개발목표 및 내용
rows.text_en: 1. Development Goals and Contents of Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology

rows.source_ko: 2. 해양수산과학기술의 연구개발 동향 및 파급효과
rows.text_en: 2. Research and Development Trends and Ripple Effects of Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology

rows.source_ko: 3. 해양수산과학기술의 시장동향 및 시장규모
rows.text_en: 3. Market Trends and Market Size of Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology

rows.source_ko: 4. 해양수산과학기술의 개발기간, 정부지원 규모 및 형태
rows.text_en: 4. Development Period, Scale, and Form of Government Support for Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology

rows.source_ko: 5. 해양수산과학기술의 연구개발 추진체계
rows.text_en: 5. Research and Development Promotion System for Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology

rows.source_ko: 6. 해양수산과학기술에 대한 평가의 주안점
rows.text_en: 6. Key Focus of the Evaluation on Marine and Fisheries Science and Technology

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 해양수산부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: ② 해양수산부장관은 해양수산 분야 기업, 연구기관, 대학, 「수산업ㆍ어촌 발전 기본법」 제3조제2호에 따른 수산인 및 수산인단체 등이 방문ㆍ우편 및 인터넷 등을 통하여 수시로 산업현장에서 필요한 해양수산과학기술을 제안할 수 있도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall allow companies, research institutions, universities, fishermen and fisheries organizations pursuant to Article 3, subparagraph 2 of the Framework Act on Fisheries and Fishing Village Development, etc., in the marine and fisheries sector to propose marine and fisheries science and technology needed in the industrial field at any time through visits, mail, the internet, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(신기술 인증 신청 및 이의신청) ① 법 제17조제1항에 따라 해양수산신기술(이하 “신기술”이라 한다)의 인증을 받으려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 신기술 인증 또는 신기술 신속인증 신청서(신기술의 상용화 및 신기술 적용 제품의 신속한 시장출시 등을 이유로 신속한 인증심사가 필요한 경우만 해당한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 진흥원의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2024. 9. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for New Technology Certification and Objection) ① Any person who intends to obtain certification for a new marine and fisheries technology (hereinafter referred to as “New Technology”) pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Head of the Promotion Agency an Application for New Technology Certification or Expedited New Technology Certification in the form of Annex No. 1 (applicable only in cases where expedited certification review is necessary for reasons such as the commercialization of the New Technology or the rapid market launch of products applying the New Technology), attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 13, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제2호서식의 기술 설명서
rows.text_en: 1. Technical description in Form No. 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 「산업표준화법」 제2조제3호에 따른 품질경영을 하고 있는 경우에는 품질경영에 대한 설명자료 또는 국제표준화기구(ISO)의 인증서(보유한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where quality management is being practiced pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Industrial Standardization Act, explanatory materials on quality management or a certificate from the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) (only applicable if possessed)

rows.source_ko: 3. 신기술에 관한 지식재산권을 가지고 있는 경우에는 그에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 3. If intellectual property rights regarding new technology are held, documents regarding such rights

rows.source_ko: 4. 국내외 공인기관으로부터 인증을 받거나 시험을 받은 경우에는 인증 실적 자료나 제품시험 성적서
rows.text_en: 4. In cases where certification or testing has been obtained from domestic or foreign accredited institutions, certification performance data or product test reports

rows.source_ko: 5. 공동연구를 하거나 기술이전을 받은 경우에는 그에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Documents regarding joint research or technology transfer in the event of such collaboration

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 진흥원의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 및 사업자등록증명(사업자등록을 한 경우만 해당한다)을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 신청인에게 그 사본을 첨부하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the Agency who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (only applicable to corporations) and the Certificate of Business Registration (only applicable to cases where a business has been registered) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the applicant shall be required to attach a copy thereof.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 진흥원의 장은 1차 심사(서류ㆍ면접심사), 2차 심사(현장확인) 및 3차 심사(종합심사)로 나누어 신기술 인증을 위한 심사ㆍ평가를 실시해야 한다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the Agency who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall conduct an examination and evaluation for new technology certification by dividing the process into a first examination (document and interview review), a second examination (on-site verification), and a third examination (comprehensive review). <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제16조제4항에 따라 이의신청을 하려는 자는 별지 제3호서식의 이의신청서에 이의신청 사유를 증명하는 자료를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 이의신청을 받은 해양수산부장관은 진흥원의 장에게 이의신청 내용을 검토하게 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ Any person who intends to file an objection pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an objection form in Annex 3 to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, attaching materials proving the grounds for the objection. In this case, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries who receives the objection may have the head of the Promotion Agency review the contents of the objection.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 해양수산부장관은 제4항 전단에 따라 이의신청을 받은 날부터 7일 이내에 제1항에 따라 신기술 인증을 신청한 자에게 그 내용을 통보하고, 이의신청에 대해 답변서를 제출할 수 있는 기회를 줘야 한다. <신설 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall, within 7 days from the date of receipt of an objection pursuant to the first part of Paragraph 4, notify the person who applied for new technology certification pursuant to Paragraph 1 of the contents thereof and provide an opportunity to submit a written response to the objection. <Newly added Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제5항에 따라 답변서를 제출하려는 자는 별지 제3호의2서식의 이의신청 답변서에 답변내용을 증명하는 자료를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <신설 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Any person who intends to submit a written response pursuant to Paragraph 5 shall submit the written response to an objection in the form of Annex 3-2 to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, attaching materials proving the contents of the response. <Newly added Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 해양수산부장관은 이의신청을 받은 날부터 60일 이내에 그 내용을 심사한 후 심사 결과를 신기술 인증 신청인 및 이의신청인에게 알려야 한다. 다만, 부득이한 사정이 있는 경우에는 이의신청에 대한 처리 기간을 연장할 수 있다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review the contents of an objection within 60 days from the date of receipt and notify the applicant for new technology certification and the objector of the review results. However, if there are unavoidable circumstances, the processing period for the objection may be extended. <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 해양수산부장관은 제7항 단서에 따라 이의신청에 대한 처리 기간을 연장하려는 경우에는 이의신청인에게 그 사유와 연장기간을 알려야 한다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ If the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intends to extend the processing period for an objection pursuant to the proviso of Paragraph 7, he/she shall notify the applicant of the reason and the extended period. <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 제1항부터 제8항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 신기술 인증ㆍ신속인증 신청, 이의신청 및 이의신청에 대한 답변서 제출에 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시한다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 8, matters necessary for applications for new technology certification and expedited certification, objections, and the submission of written responses to objections shall be determined by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries and announced by public notice . <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(신기술 인증 유효기간의 연장 신청) ① 법 제17조제4항에 따라 신기술 인증 유효기간의 연장을 받으려는 자는 인증 유효기간이 끝나는 날의 6개월 전부터 2개월 전까지 별지 제4호서식의 신기술 인증 유효기간 연장신청서에 연장사유에 대한 증명자료를 첨부하여 진흥원의 장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Extension of Validity Period of New Technology Certification) ① Any person who wishes to obtain an extension of the validity period of a new technology certification pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall submit an application for extension of the validity period of a new technology certification in the form of Annex No. 4, attached with supporting documents regarding the reasons for the extension, to the head of the Promotion Agency between six months and two months prior to the expiration of the validity period of the certification.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 진흥원의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 및 사업자등록증명(사업자등록을 한 경우만 해당한다)을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 신청인에게 그 사본을 첨부하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the Agency who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (only applicable to corporations) and the Certificate of Business Registration (only applicable to cases where a business has been registered) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the applicant shall be required to attach a copy thereof.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따른 신기술 인증 유효기간의 연장을 신청할 수 있는 대상은 인증 유효기간이 끝나는 날을 기준으로 하여 영 제15조제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 기술로서 아직 상용화가 되지 아니한 신기술 또는 상용화된 지 1년 이내인 신기술로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The subjects eligible to apply for an extension of the validity period of the new technology certification under Paragraph 1 shall be new technologies that fall under any of the subparagraphs of Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree as of the date the certification validity period expires, which have not yet been commercialized or have been commercialized within one year.

rows.source_ko: ④ 해양수산부장관은 영 제15조제2항에 따른 신기술 인증의 기준을 검토하여 인증 유효기간의 연장 여부 및 연장 기간을 결정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review the standards for new technology certification pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree and determine whether to extend the validity period of the certification and the period of extension.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항부터 제4항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 신기술 인증 유효기간 연장에 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the extension of the validity period of new technology certification shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(신기술 인증서의 발급 등) ① 영 제17조제1항에 따른 신기술 인증서(이하 “인증서”라 한다)는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Issuance of New Technology Certificate, etc.) ① The new technology certificate pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “certificate”)shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 인증서를 발급받은 자가 영문 인증서를 발급받으려면 별지 제5호의2서식의 영문 신기술 인증서 신청서에 인증서 사본을 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② If a person who has been issued a certificate wishes to obtain an English version of the certificate, they must submit an application for an English New Technology Certificate in the form of Annex 5-2 , attaching a copy of the certificate, to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 해양수산부장관은 제2항에 따른 신청을 받으면 별지 제6호서식의 영문 신기술 인증서를 발급해야 한다. <신설 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall issue an English New Technology Certification in the form of Annex 6. <Newly added Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제17조제1항에 따라 인증서를 발급받은 자는 인증서가 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 별지 제7호서식의 해양수산신기술 인증서 재발급 신청서에 증명자료와 인증서(훼손되었거나 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 인증서의 재발급을 신청할 수 있다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ④ A person who has been issued a certificate pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree may apply to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries for the reissuance of the certificate by attaching supporting documents and the certificate (only applicable if it is damaged or the details have been changed) to the Application for Reissuance of Certificate of New Marine and Fisheries Technology (Form No. 7) if the certificate falls under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 인증서를 분실하거나 인증서가 훼손된 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In case the certificate is lost or damaged

rows.source_ko: 2. 인증서를 받은 기관의 명칭, 대표자 성명 또는 소재지가 변경된 경우
rows.text_en: 2. If the name, representative's name, or address of the institution that received the certificate has changed

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에 따라 인증서의 재발급 신청을 받은 해양수산부장관은 그 신청 내용이 적합한 경우 인증서를 신청인에게 발급해야 한다. <개정 2021. 1. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries who receives an application for the reissuance of a certificate pursuant to Paragraph 4 shall issue the certificate to the applicant if the contents of the application are appropriate. <Amended Jan. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(신기술 인증의 표시방법 등) ① 법 제18조제1항에 따른 신기술 인증의 표시방법은 별표와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Method of Marking New Technology Certification, etc.) ①The method of marking new technology certification pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act is as set forth in the attached table .

rows.source_ko: ② 신기술 인증의 표시는 법 제17조제2항에 따른 인증 유효기간 또는 같은 조 제3항에 따라 연장된 유효기간 내에 신기술을 이용하여 제조한 제품이나 그 제품의 포장ㆍ용기 및 홍보물 등에만 사용할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The mark of new technology certification may only be used on products manufactured using the new technology or on the packaging, containers, and promotional materials of such products within the validity period of certification pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 2 of the Act or the validity period extended pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 3 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: ③ 진흥원의 장은 필요한 경우 신기술 인증을 받은 자에게 신기술 인증의 표시를 사용한 내용 및 실적에 관한 자료의 제출을 요청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ If necessary, the head of the Agency may request the person who has received new technology certification to submit data regarding the use of the new technology certification mark and performance results.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인 신청 등) ① 법 제19조의2제2항에 따라 신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인을 받으려는 자는 별지 제8호서식의 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 진흥원의 장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Application for Confirmation of Products/Facilities Applying New Technology, etc.) ①Any person who wishes to obtain confirmation of products/facilities applying new technology pursuant to Article 19-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit an application in the form of Annex 8 to the head of the Promotion Agency, attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 설명서(세부 기재 내용은 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시하는 바에 따라 적어야 한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Description of products and facilities applying new technology (detailed contents must be written in accordance with the regulations prescribed and notified by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries )

rows.source_ko: 2. 「국가표준기본법」 제23조제2항에 따른 인정기구에서 인정한 시험기관의 시험성적서 또는 성능확인자료
rows.text_en: 2. Test reports or performance verification data from a testing institution accredited by an accreditation body pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Framework Act on National Standards

rows.source_ko: 3. 「산업표준화법」 제2조제3호에 따른 품질경영과 관련된 활동을 하고 있는지에 대한 국제표준화기구(ISO)의 인증서 등 설명자료
rows.text_en: 3. Explanatory materials, such as an International Organization for Standardization (ISO) certificate, regarding whether activities related to quality management pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Industrial Standardization Act are being conducted

rows.source_ko: 4. 다른 법률에서 해당 제품 또는 시설에 대하여 사용 전 검사ㆍ검증 등을 필요로 하는 경우에는 그 절차를 거쳤음을 증명하는 자료
rows.text_en: 4. In cases where other laws require pre-use inspection, verification, etc. for the relevant product or facility, materials proving that such procedures have been completed

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 진흥원의 장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 및 사업자등록증명(사업자등록을 한 경우만 해당한다)을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증명의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 신청인에게 그 사본을 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the Agency who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (only applicable to corporations) and the Certificate of Business Registration (only applicable to cases where a business has been registered) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the applicant shall be required to attach a copy thereof.

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제18조의2제3항에 따라 의견을 제출하려는 자는 별지 제3호서식의 의견제출서에 의견을 제출하는 사유를 증명하는 자료를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다. 이 경우 의견을 제출받은 해양수산부장관은 진흥원의 장에게 제출된 의견을 검토하게 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ Any person who intends to submit an opinion pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an opinion submission form in Annex 3 to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, attaching materials proving the reasons for submitting the opinion. In this case, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries who receives the opinion may have the head of the Promotion Agency review the submitted opinion.

rows.source_ko: ④ 해양수산부장관은 제3항 전단에 따라 의견을 제출받은 날부터 7일 이내에 신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인을 신청한 자에게 그 내용을 통보하고, 제출된 의견에 대해 답변서를 제출할 수 있는 기회를 주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall, within 7 days from the date of receiving the opinion pursuant to the first part of Paragraph 3, notify the person who applied for confirmation of products or facilities applying new technology of the contents thereof and give them an opportunity to submit a written response to the submitted opinion.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에 따라 답변서를 제출하려는 자는 같은 항에 따른 통보를 받은 날부터 15일 이내에 별지 제3호의2서식의 답변서에 답변내용을 증명하는 자료를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Any person who intends to submit a written response pursuant to Paragraph 4 shall submit a written response in the form of Annex 3-2 to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries within 15 days from the date of receiving the notification pursuant to the same paragraph, with materials proving the contents of the response attached.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 해양수산부장관은 제3항 전단에 따라 의견을 제출받은 날부터 60일 이내에 그 내용을 검토한 후 검토 결과를 신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인 신청인 및 의견을 제출한 자에게 알려야 한다. 다만, 부득이한 사정이 있는 경우에는 처리 기간을 연장할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review the contents of the opinion submitted pursuant to the first part of Paragraph 3 within 60 days from the date of receipt and notify the applicant for confirmation of products/facilities applying new technology and the person who submitted the opinion of the results of the review. However, if there are unavoidable circumstances, the processing period may be extended.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 해양수산부장관은 제6항 단서에 따라 처리 기간을 연장하려는 경우에는 신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인 신청인 및 의견을 제출한 자에게 그 사유와 연장기간을 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ If the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intends to extend the processing period pursuant to the proviso of Paragraph 6, he/she shall notify the applicant for confirmation of products/facilities applying new technology and the person who submitted the opinion of the reason and the extended period.

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 제1항부터 제7항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인 신청, 의견 제출 등에 필요한 사항은 해양수산부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ⑧ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 7, matters necessary for the application for verification of products and facilities applying new technology, submission of opinions, etc. shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인서의 발급 등) ① 영 제18조의2제5항에 따른 확인서(이하 “확인서”라 한다)는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Issuance of Confirmation Certificate for Products/Facilities Applying New Technology, etc.) ① The confirmation certificate pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “confirmation certificate”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Appendix .

rows.source_ko: ② 확인서를 발급받은 자가 영문 확인서를 발급받으려면 별지 제5호의2서식의 영문 신기술 적용제품ㆍ시설 확인서 신청서에 확인서 사본을 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If a person who has been issued a certificate wishes to obtain an English certificate, they must submit an application for a certificate of confirmation of new technology applied products/facilities in English (Form No. 5-2) to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, attaching a copy of the certificate.

rows.source_ko: ③ 해양수산부장관은 제2항에 따른 신청을 받으면 별지 제10호서식의 영문 확인서를 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application pursuant to paragraph 2, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall issue an English confirmation in the form of Annex 10 .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제18조의2제5항에 따라 확인서를 발급받은 자는 확인서가 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 별지 제7호서식의 확인서 재발급 신청서에 확인서(훼손되었거나 기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)와 기재사항이 변경되었음을 증명하는 서류(기재사항이 변경된 경우만 해당한다)를 첨부하여 해양수산부장관에게 확인서의 재발급을 신청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ A person who has received a certificate pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree may apply to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries for the reissuance of a certificate in any of the following cases by attaching the certificate (only if it is damaged or the details have been changed) and documents proving that the details have been changed (only if the details have been changed) to the application for reissuance of a certificate in Form No. 7 of the Annex.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of Science and Technology in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries and Food is amended as follows.

rows.text_en: In Article 1, “「Agricultural, Forestry, Fisheries and Food Science and Technology Promotion Act」” shall be changed to “「Agricultural, Forestry and Food Science and Technology Promotion Act」”.

rows.text_en: In the first part of Article 2, Paragraph 1, excluding the subparagraphs, “Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be changed to “Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs”, and “Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of Agriculture, Food and Rural Science and Technology” shall be changed to “Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of Agriculture, Food and Rural Science and Technology”; in Subparagraph 2 of the same paragraph, “agricultural, food and rural science and technology” shall be changed to “agricultural and rural science and technology”; and in Subparagraph 3 of the same paragraph, “fields of agriculture, food and rural science and technology recognized by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be changed to “fields of agriculture, food and rural science and technology recognized by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs”; and in the first part of Paragraph 2 of the same Article, Paragraph 3, the main text of Paragraph 4, and Paragraph 6 of the same Article, “Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be changed to “Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs”.

rows.source_ko: 제3조 각 호 외의 부분 중 “농림축산식품부령 또는 해양수산부령”을 “농림축산식품부령”으로 하고, 같은 조 제1호 및 제2호 중 “농림축산식품부장관 또는 해양수산부장관”을 각각 “농림축산식품부장관”으로 한다.

rows.text_en: The title of Article 4, “(Preparation of Classification System for Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries, and Food Science and Technology)”, shall be changed to “(Preparation of Classification System for Agriculture, Forestry, and Food Science and Technology)”; in Paragraph 1 of the same article, “Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Food or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be changed to “Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Food”; “Act on the Promotion of Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries and Food Science and Technology” shall be changed to “Act on the Promotion of Agriculture, Forestry, and Food Science and Technology”; and “Classification System for Agriculture, Forestry, and Food Science and Technology or Classification System for Fisheries and Food Science and Technology” shall be changed to “Classification System for Agriculture, Forestry, and Food Science and Technology”; in Paragraph 2 of the same article, “Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Food or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be changed to “Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Food”; and in Paragraph 3 of the same article, “Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Food or Minister of Oceans and Fisheries in the field of agriculture, forestry, and fisheries and food science and technology” shall be changed to “Minister of Agriculture, Forestry, and Food in the field of agriculture, forestry, and food science and technology”.

rows.text_en:
In Item 1 of Annex 2, “the Act on the Promotion of Science and Technology in Agriculture, Forestry, Fisheries and Food” shall be changed to “the Act on the Promotion of Science and Technology in Agriculture, Forestry, and Food”, and “the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be changed to “the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs”, and in Subparagraph (a) of the same item, “new technology in agriculture and food, new technology in fisheries food” shall be changed to “new technology in agriculture and food”.

<!-- body-asset:a71e01412ab6986935c4fbcb -->
![Original inline image](https://www.law.go.kr/LSW/flDownload.do?flSeq=30252371)

**Form No. 1 — Application for Certification of New Technology in Agricultural and Forestry Food**

The title of Form No. 1 is changed from “Application for Certification of New Technology in Agricultural and Forestry Food” to “Application for Certification of New Technology in Agricultural, Forestry and Fisheries Food Science and Technology.” In the same form, each reference to “Agricultural, Forestry and Fisheries Food Science and Technology” is replaced with “Agricultural, Forestry and Food Science and Technology”; each reference to “the President of the Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute or the President of the Korea Institute of Marine Science and Technology Promotion” is replaced with “the President of the Agricultural and Forestry Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute.” In item 2 of the supporting-documents section, the phrase “whether a quality management system under Article 2(2) of the Quality Management and Industrial Product Safety Management Act is in place” is replaced with “where quality management is carried out under Article 2(3) of the Industrial Standardization Act, matters concerning quality management.” In the processing-procedure section, “the Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute or the Korea Institute of Marine Science and Technology Promotion” is replaced with “the Agricultural and Forestry Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute,” and “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” is replaced with “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.”

<!-- body-asset:a7d6a2e1f4b4a5b341c2fc2b -->
![Original inline image](https://www.law.go.kr/LSW/flDownload.do?flSeq=30252442)

**Form No. 1-2 — Application for Expedited Certification of New Technology**

The title of Form No. 1-2 is changed from “Application for Expedited Certification of New Technology in Agricultural and Forestry Food” to “Application for Expedited Certification of New Technology” with the applicable “Agricultural and Forestry Food” and “Fisheries Food” categories. In the same form, each reference to “Agricultural, Forestry and Fisheries Food Science and Technology” is replaced with “Agricultural, Forestry and Food Science and Technology”; each reference to “the President of the Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute or the President of the Korea Institute of Marine Science and Technology Promotion” is replaced with “the President of the Agricultural and Forestry Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute.” In item 2 of the applicant’s supporting-documents section, the phrase “whether a quality management system under Article 2(2) of the Quality Management and Industrial Product Safety Management Act is in place” is replaced with “where quality management is carried out under Article 2(3) of the Industrial Standardization Act, matters concerning quality management.” In the processing-procedure section, “the Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute or the Korea Institute of Marine Science and Technology Promotion” is replaced with “the Agricultural and Forestry Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute,” and “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” is replaced with “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.”

**Form No. 3 — Application for Objection to New Technology Certification**

The title of Form No. 3 is changed to “Application for Objection to New Technology Certification” with the applicable “Agricultural and Forestry Food” and “Fisheries Food” categories. In the same form, each reference to “Agricultural, Forestry and Fisheries Food Science and Technology” is replaced with “Agricultural, Forestry and Food Science and Technology”; each reference to “the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” is replaced with “the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.” In the processing-procedure section, each reference to “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” is replaced with “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs,” and “the Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute or the Korea Institute of Marine Science and Technology Promotion” is replaced with “the Agricultural and Forestry Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute.”

![Original inline image](https://www.law.go.kr/LSW/flDownload.do?flSeq=30252919)

**Form No. 4 — Application for Extension of the Validity Period of New Technology Certification**

The title of Form No. 4 is changed from “Application for Extension of the Validity Period of New Technology Certification in Agricultural and Forestry Food” to “Application for Extension of the Validity Period of New Technology Certification.” In the same form, each reference to “Agricultural, Forestry and Fisheries Food Science and Technology” is replaced with “Agricultural, Forestry and Food Science and Technology”; each reference to “the President of the Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute or the President of the Korea Institute of Marine Science and Technology Promotion” is replaced with “the President of the Agricultural and Forestry Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute.” In the processing-procedure section, “the Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute or the Korea Institute of Marine Science and Technology Promotion” is replaced with “the Agricultural and Forestry Food Technology Planning and Evaluation Institute,” and “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” is replaced with “the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.”

<!-- body-asset:febb5a951e96af42f2bb958d -->

**Form No. 5 — Terminology Amendments**

In Form No. 5, each reference to “Agricultural, Forestry and Fisheries Food Science and Technology” is replaced with “Agricultural, Forestry and Food Science and Technology,” and “the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” is replaced with “the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs.”
